name: 01_clinical_questions
caption: A conceptual separation of clinical questions. This is not a self-diagnosis or staging algorithm. The relevant clinical pathway depends on the person and findings.

name: 02_screening_evidence
caption: Questions for appraising a screening claim. Improved test performance does not by itself answer every question about benefit, harm or implementation.

name: 03_confusion_counts
caption: Executed internal holdout counts at threshold 0.5, with malignant as the positive class. The 143 selected diagnostic cases are not a population screening cohort.

name: 04_training_and_holdout
caption: The executed evaluation design. The bundled data omit original identifiers; row separation does not independently verify grouped patient separation.

name: 05_prevalence_and_ppv
caption: Mathematical illustration using assumed fixed sensitivity and specificity. These are not measured screening estimates and are not transported from the diagnostic classifier.

name: 06_masai_interval_ratio
caption: A plot of the reported MASAI interval-cancer ratio 0.88 with 95% confidence interval 0.65 to 1.18. The trial established non-inferiority under its prespecified margin; this interval does not establish superior reduction or a mortality benefit. This figure is a visualization of published summary statistics, not a reanalysis of patient data.

name: 07_synthetic_data_questions
caption: A conceptual appraisal of synthetic imaging. Plausibility alone does not establish privacy, representative coverage or clinical usefulness.

name: 08_target_evidence
caption: A simplified evidence map rather than an executable vaccine pipeline. Binding, presentation, recognition, safety and clinical benefit are distinct endpoints.

name: 09_vaccine_endpoints
caption: These endpoints are related but not interchangeable. Immune responses alone do not establish lower recurrence or longer survival.

name: 10_generation_and_evaluation
caption: Generative proposal and predictive estimation play different roles. The diagram does not assert that the companion implements a biological generator or produces a clinically usable vaccine.

name: 11_fictional_rank_sensitivity
caption: Executed sensitivity analysis of fictional, unitless records under arbitrary weight draws. The fractions describe this scoring exercise and are not probabilities of immunogenicity, safety or vaccine efficacy.

name: 12_reproducible_project
caption: A conceptual structure for an inspectable project. Reproducibility supports appraisal but does not by itself establish external validity or clinical benefit.
